messages:
OptiCart: Hey team — since last night's rollout our invoice summarization started dropping currency symbols. e.g. we get 'Total: 100' instead of '$100'. Affects multiple tenants. Request id: req_9b2f. Can someone triage?

anna-cs: Sorry about that, @OptiCart — we'll triage. Can you paste a tiny failing example (prompt + model response), request id and the approximate timestamp so we can fetch prompt logs and token-level output?

OptiCart: Example (minimal):
Input: Summarize invoice: items: ["Widget A - 50 USD"]
Observed output: Total: 50
Timestamp: 2026-03-15T02:32:10Z
Request id: req_9b2f
This is from our Dedicated pool in nyc.

anna-cs: Thanks. @jordan-ml @mike-ops tagging eng/runtime — any known rollouts or tokenizer changes overnight?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed: redwood-runtime v2.4.0 -> all-hosted/dedicated (2026-03-15T01:10:00Z). Canary 1% earlier at 2026-03-14T23:50:00Z.

jordan-ml: Noted. Could be tokenizer or a model/token merging behavior. We'll need: model name/version from request header, X-Routing-Policy, and the prompt log id if you have it. Also helpful: whether pinning to redwood-1.2 reproduces or not.

OptiCart: Headers we see: X-Model: redwood-1.3, X-Routing-Policy: default, tenant: opt_cart_tenant. Minimal curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"redwood-1.3","input":"Summarize invoice: items: [\"Widget A - 50 USD\"]"}'
```

anna-cs: Perfect. If you can also share the prompt log id (pl_*) that will let us pull token streams. If you can run the same curl but pin model to redwood-1.2 and paste result that helps isolate whether it's model vs runtime.

OptiCart: Prompt log id: pl_0a1b2c3. I ran pinned to redwood-1.2 and got: Total: $50 — so looks like regression introduced between 1.2 -> 1.3 and/or runtime v2.4.0.

mike-ops: Thanks — I'm running a quick canary repro in our staging dedicated pool. I can reproduce the missing '$' when routing to redwood-1.3 on v2.4.0. Looks like token merging/normalization in the runtime path. Opening infra ticket INFRA-3123.

jordan-ml: I pulled tokenizer diffs: on redwood-1.2 '$' was kept as separate token adjacent to numbers, on 1.3 config there was a normalization change that can collapse the currency sign into numeric token depending on runtime tokenization glue. That plus a runtime optimization in v2.4.0 (kv-cache normalization) explains missing symbol in some outputs. We'll prepare a tokenization patch and a model config revert.

anna-cs: Short-term options: 1) Force-route your tenant to redwood-1.2, 2) rollback runtime to v2.3.9, or 3) add an explicit instruction in prompts to include currency (workaround). Which would you prefer for immediate mitigation?

OptiCart: Please force-route to 1.2 for now, that minimizes risk on our side. We'll take prompt changes if you need a quick stopgap but prefer platform fix.

mike-ops: Applying forced route now for tenant opt_cart_tenant -> redwood-1.2. ETA ~10m. Posting update shortly.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing override applied: tenant=opt_cart_tenant -> model=redwood-1.2 (2026-03-15T02:05:00Z).

OptiCart: Confirming now — responses return 'Total: $50'. Thank you, that fixes it on our end.

anna-cs: Great — we'll keep the forced route until eng ships a permanent patch. Jordan/mike, please post root-cause summary and ETA for a rollback/patch. We'll compile a short postmortem for OptiCart and affected tenants (INC-2026-3123).

jordan-ml: Will do. Root cause: tokenizer config change + runtime kv-cache normalization in v2.4.0. Action plan: patch tokenizer config in redwood-1.3 and ship runtime hotfix v2.4.1; target ETA 48 hours. If tests pass sooner we'll accelerate.

anna-cs: Thanks all — OptiCart, we'll keep you updated and follow up with logs (token-level) once internal ticket updates are available. Appreciate the quick repro. :pray:
